name: Auxiliares Exculcatores

abilities.name: Rapid Advance
abilities.text: Improved unit movement speed over an extended period.

abilities.name: Precision Shot
abilities.text: Improved missile weapon damage for an extended period. These values are further modified by the unit itself.

abilities.name: Testudo
abilities.text: The troops of this unit raise their shields above their heads in a defensive formation.

abilities.name: Square
abilities.text: The unit moves into a close square formation. Note that it cannot move whilst this ability is active.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.text: The unit moves into a close formation and raises shields.

attributes.name: Campaign Stealth
attributes.text: This unit can move around the campaign map without being seen.

attributes.name: Resistant to Fatigue
attributes.text: Fatigue has less of an effect on this unit.

attributes.name: Guerrilla Deployment
attributes.text: This unit can deploy outside of the deployment zone.

attributes.name: Hide (scrub & forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in scrub and forest until enemy units get too close.

attributes.name: Ignore Terrain
attributes.text: Speed penalties caused by the terrain are ignored by this unit.

attributes.name: Snipe
attributes.text: This unit remains hidden while firing.

short: The name Exculcatores means «those who tread the ground» or «tramplers»; they are described in the military manual of Vegetius, in the following terms: «After (the first line) came the ferentarii and (other) light infantry, which we now call exculcatores and armaturas..., they, rushing out in front of the main line, engaged the enemies in battle». In the Notitia Dignitatum - Exculcatores seniores and Exculcatores iuniores are among the warriors of the Auxilia Palatina. In the Western Empire, the Exculcatores iuniores Britanniciani are listed as one of the units of the Auxilia Palatina of Magister Peditum. The other two units from Notitia bear the name Exculcatores seniores and Exculcatores iuniores. Both are listed in the list of Magister Peditum as units of the Auxilia Palatina, and also occupy a higher position in the unit list.
history: Exculcatores' were ranged infantry units that operated as part of the Auxilia Palatina - Legions of auxiliaries created during Constantine the Great's military reforms of the early 4th century AD. They were formed of local troops, and often took the names of the tribes from which they were drafted. As auxiliaries, it is safe to assume that exculcatores operated along the frontiers, stationed in Gaul or Britannia. Although there is reference to their acting as standard javelinmen, the Notitia Dignitatum contains some evidence that exculcatores were specialist units, used for tracking in conjunction with another scouting corps known as 'exploratores'.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
